title: Payouts Desk Rule Note: Payout Holds, Hold Reasons and Earnings Account Status
content:
## The rule

Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**:

1. An earnings account becomes active once its payout destination is verified; until then earnings accrue but nothing is paid out.
2. Payouts are held for one of four recorded reasons:
   - **bank verification failed**, when the payout destination is rejected;
   - **negative balance**, when the available balance is at or below the negative balance hold threshold of -150.00;
   - **fraud review**, when trips on the account are under fraud review;
   - **deactivation for fraud**, when the driver services agreement is deactivated for fraud.
3. A hold is lifted only when its reason is resolved: a verified new payout destination for bank verification failed, the balance recovering above -150.00 for negative balance, a cleared review for fraud review. A fraud review hold cannot last more than 30 calendar days and is then lifted unless the agreement has been deactivated for fraud, and a deactivation-for-fraud hold is lifted only if the deactivation is reversed on appeal.
4. Earnings keep posting while payouts are held.
5. Switching the payout method between bank deposit and the Wayfare debit card is the driver's own decision and takes effect from the next payout.
6. The account closes when the driver services agreement closes, after the last payout it is owed.

The hold reason and the available balance recorded on the earnings account are the evidence for lifting a hold.

## When a recorded hold reason counts as resolved

| Recorded hold reason | Resolved when the records show |
|---|---|
| Bank verification failed | A verified new payout destination |
| Negative balance | An available balance above -150.00 |
| Fraud review | A cleared review; or the review hold has lasted 30 calendar days and the agreement has not been deactivated for fraud |
| Deactivation for fraud | The deactivation reversed on appeal |

## Account statuses in business terms

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Awaiting payout setup | Opened with a driver services agreement; the payout destination is not yet verified; earnings accrue, nothing is paid out |
| Active | The payout destination is verified; payouts and instant cashouts work |
| On payout hold | Payouts and instant cashouts are held for a recorded hold reason; earnings keep posting |
| Closed | The driver services agreement has closed and the final balance has been paid out; or the agreement closed while payouts were held, any balance being settled under the hold outcome; or the agreement closed before payouts were ever set up |

A hold is placed on an active account and, when lifted, the account returns to active.

## Negative balance on both sides

| Available balance on a hypothetical account | Negative-balance position |
|---|---|
| -150.00 | At the threshold: payouts held for negative balance; not resolved |
| -150.01 | Below the threshold: held; not resolved |
| -149.99 | Above the threshold: a negative-balance hold is resolved |
| 25.00 | Above the threshold: a negative-balance hold is resolved |
